problem: E33 found a real discrepancy from a single read-through, but that finding had not yet been independently re-verified with fresh reads before being trusted as the basis for a real Evolution Candidate.

decision.decision_summary: Independently re-read all 4 real artifacts (Experience, overlay, trace, priority) fresh. Discrepancy confirmed still real and unchanged: Experience+overlay say satisfied, trace+priority still say otherwise. Evolution judgment: EVOLUTION_CANDIDATE. E33's existing candidate (cand_evolution_trace_v15_ghibli_status_staleness_v1) re-validated, not duplicated -- 0 new candidates.

action.action_summary: Re-read exp_phase959, overlay v6, trace v15, development-priority-v1 fresh; recorded only literal field disagreement (no new inference); made 0 corrections to any file.

result.note: Independently re-verifies E33's finding; does not modify trace v15, overlay v6, or development-priority-v1; does not change this Goal's own real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: A single-pass finding (E33) had not yet been independently re-derived from fresh reads to rule out a transcription error or a since-changed real state before being treated as confirmed.

lesson: Independent re-verification from fresh reads (not trusting a prior phase's own summary) is what actually confirms a finding is real -- here it held exactly as reported, which is itself evidence the original E33 read was accurate, not merely evidence that this phase copied it correctly.
